decisions.reason: As the flagship shown on the home page and aligned with the firm's direction in a growing industry, it likely meets aspirations and gets continued investment.
Its dedicated page signals commitment, and it supports the firm's electronic document workflow strategy, so the growing firm's slack lets it carry the product while results mature.
It builds on the core fax and messaging competence at low marginal cost, and with no shortfall evident there is no trigger for problemistic search to drop it.
It is a low-cost feature close to the established fax business that strengthens existing services and is unlikely to be removed.
Sandbox threat protection is increasingly demanded in regulated markets and complements the security portfolio, so dropping it would be inconsistent with aspirations.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a standard part of the core secure messaging offer and costs little to maintain, so it is kept.
